payload.title: Delivery pricing is no longer total: _staged_proof_runs calls classify_red_first, which raises red_first_change_chain_missing for a staged action whose change has no planned row, and neither the drain's per-request pricing nor delivery_admission_refusal (documented to return a string or None) handles it
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/apply_engine.py:959-976 (classify_red_first raises GovernanceError for a staged change with no planned row)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/implementation_delivery.py:755-772 (the admission's try covers the sandbox only; the pricing call at 769 is outside it)
tools/aria-poc/ci_executor_drain.py:1322-1327 (the drain prices each request with no handler)
tools/aria-poc/ci_executor.py:5537-5545 (the pre-spawn pricing and admission run while the claim is held)
payload.rule_violated: Refuse by name, never by an unhandled exception (delivery_admission_refusal's own contract returns a refusal string or None; CLAUDE.md root-cause rule): a pricing function that gained a raise path must stay total or be handled at every caller.
payload.notes: A restored or partially published store holds an apply action whose change_id has no change_planned row (the stager writes the planned row first, so only an inconsistent store reaches this). The drain's per-request pricing at ci_executor_drain.py:1324 then raises out of drain_pending, so the request is neither skipped by name nor claimed and every later drain trips on it again; the executor's pre-spawn call raises while the claim is held instead of releasing it with a named refusal. Close condition: Make pricing and admission total: price an unclassifiable action at the conservative proof count, or catch the GovernanceError at the callers and return a named refusal (a drain skip by name, an admission string); a test with a staged action whose change has no planned row asserts staged_delivery_worst_case_seconds and delivery_admission_refusal do not raise. Verified at origin/main ae2958653d.
